reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Colorado
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: "Is it specified what must be included on the summons?"
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (question facts)
   ========================= */

% The user is asking about Colorado law in 2021.
scenario_state(colorado).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The question concerns a summons issued in an eviction / FED action under the article.
% We model that the summons is "issued pursuant to  13-40-111".
scenario_summons_issued_pursuant_to(co_rev_stat_13_40_111).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement we encoded is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(colorado),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_summons_issued_pursuant_to(co_rev_stat_13_40_111).

/* ==========================================
   Statute translations (deterministic rules)
   ========================================== */

% --- CO Code  13-40-111 (2021): Summons issuance and required contents ---

% statute_summons_must_include/3 enumerates required inclusions for a summons
% issued pursuant to CO Rev Stat  13-40-111 (2021).
%
% We encode the statute as a set of required "content items" that must be included
% on the summons (command + notices + attached forms/resources).
statute_summons_must_include(colorado, 2021, command_to_appear(place_named_in_summons, time_and_day_specified)).
statute_summons_must_include(colorado, 2021, appearance_date_constraints(not_less_than_7_days_not_more_than_14_days_from_issuance)).
statute_summons_must_include(colorado, 2021, statement_to_defendant_about_default_judgment_and_answering_requirements).
statute_summons_must_include(colorado, 2021, boldface_notice(records_suppressed_until_possession_order_and_may_remain_private_by_agreement)).
statute_summons_must_include(colorado, 2021, list_of_resources_with(website_link, phone_number, for(residential_tenants_civil_legal_aid_and_rental_assistance))).
statute_summons_must_include(colorado, 2021, copy_of_blank_answer_form_required_by(co_rev_stat_13_40_113)).
statute_summons_must_include(colorado, 2021, form_to_request_documents_in_possession_of_both_parties_relevant_to_action).

% Also from  13-40-111(2021): the court cannot enter default judgment for possession
% before close of business on the appearance due date. (Not "included on summons", but
% part of the statute and potentially relevant background.)
statute_no_default_possession_before_close_of_business_on_appearance_due_date(colorado, 2021).

% --- CO Code  13-40-112 (2021): Service requirements (not asked, but encoded) ---

% Service rules: copy of the complaint must be served with the summons.
statute_service_requires_copy_of_complaint_with_summons(colorado, 2021).

% --- CO Code  13-40-110 (2021): Complaint contents (not asked, but encoded) ---

% Complaint must describe property, grounds, name of occupant, prayer for possession, etc.
statute_complaint_must_include(colorado, 2021, property_description_reasonably_certain).
statute_complaint_must_include(colorado, 2021, grounds_for_recovery).
statute_complaint_must_include(colorado, 2021, name_of_person_in_possession_or_occupancy).
statute_complaint_must_include(colorado, 2021, prayer_for_recovery_of_possession).

/* ==================================
   Reasoning helpers (no hardcoding)
   ================================== */

% statute_specifies_summons_inclusions/4 gathers all required inclusions.
% Deterministic: returns a sorted list of items.
statute_specifies_summons_inclusions(State, Year, Authority, ItemsSorted) :-
    Authority = co_rev_stat_13_40_111,
    findall(Item, statute_summons_must_include(State, Year, Item), Items),
    sort(Items, ItemsSorted).

% specified_what_must_be_included_on_summons/0 succeeds if, under the scenario,
% the statute provides at least one required inclusion.
specified_what_must_be_included_on_summons :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_summons_issued_pursuant_to(Authority),
    statute_specifies_summons_inclusions(State, Year, Authority, Items),
    Items \= [].

/* =========================
   Answer predicate
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    specified_what_must_be_included_on_summons,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it specified what must be included on the summons?
